title: Multi-product bootstrap charter (Pi + FirstMate now; Herdr deferred)
mission: Coordinate the bounded successor program after the multi-product charter and FirstMate crew-runtime ADR integrated: prove Pi on an authorized Windows Admin Box, refresh and certify FirstMate through WSL/Ubuntu without reviving ASB child-bus orchestration, encode the GNHF narrow boundary, continue the separately-owned OpenCode LSP field proof, keep Herdr deferred, and converge stale PR/plan truth only after successor containment is proven.

owner.surface: Multi-product bootstrap charter and successor execution map

wave: 2 - bounded successor execution after charter integration
safeParallelWork: Wave A may run FirstMate interop refresh, Pi Admin Box field proof, GNHF NARROW contract work, and ASQ-005 OpenCode fresh-TUI LSP runtime certification concurrently because their tracked write surfaces are disjoint; runtime-only lanes must not commit local receipts.

FirstMate foundation owns tooling/firstmate/** foundation surfaces and its focused tests; GNHF owns tooling/gnhf/** plus its focused boundary test; Pi field proof is local runtime evidence only; ASQ-005 owns local OpenCode LSP runtime evidence only unless a reproducible product defect is proven.
Pi Remove implementation waits for Pi field-state evidence and owns only Pi bootstrap/lifecycle surfaces; FirstMate Windows bridge/operational harness waits for the refreshed FirstMate foundation.
FirstMate physical WSL proof waits for the refreshed bridge/harness; the first local-only crew pilot waits for that WSL floor.

Final convergence waits for terminal evidence or explicit blockers from Pi reversibility, FirstMate crew proof, GNHF narrowing, and ASQ-005; it is the sole owner of final plan/ledger/stale-PR disposition.

Pi field proof and OpenCode LSP proof are operator/runtime lanes; their local receipts remain untracked.
GNHF NARROW is independent of FirstMate implementation files but must cite the accepted ADR.

Final convergence is the only lane authorized to close/supersede stale PRs based on successor containment.
